packages.name: Standard Free
packages.description: Zero upfront cost publishing package including basic distribution, ISBN, and author dashboard access.

packages.name: Bestseller Breakthrough
packages.description: Premium paid publishing package with dedicated marketing campaigns, enhanced cover design, and expanded global distribution add-ons.

facilities.inHouse: Delhi in-house printing facility and central warehouse

royalty.split: 80/20 (80% net profit to Author, 20% to BookLeaf)
royalty.formula: Net profit = MRP - printing cost - platform commission (Amazon/Flipkart) - shipping charges
royalty.schedule: Calculated quarterly, disbursed within 45 days of quarter ending
royalty.threshold: ₹1,000 minimum payout threshold. Balances under ₹1,000 rollover automatically to next quarter.
royalty.paymentMethod: Direct bank transfer to linked account in Author Dashboard
royalty.transparency: Full line-by-line sales breakdown per platform available in author dashboard

isbn.imprint: Registered under BookLeaf Publishing publisher imprint. Independent imprint requires author to provide their own ISBN.
isbn.discrepancySLA: High-priority issue. Escalated immediately to production team with guaranteed 48-hour resolution.

printingAndQuality.turnaround: Standard turnaround is 5–7 business days from order confirmation.
printingAndQuality.partners: In-house Delhi facility for standard orders; Repro India and Epitome Books for overflow and specialized formats.
printingAndQuality.defectPolicy: Free reprint arranged upon verification. Author must submit photos of defects (misprints, binding defects, color inconsistency). Reprint SLA: 5–7 business days.

distribution.listingSLA: 7–10 business days after publication is complete.
distribution.stockSyncIssue: 'Currently Unavailable' status on marketplace listings is typically a stock sync lag. BookLeaf triggers a catalog re-sync within 24–48 hours.

policies.productionBottlenecks: Most delays occur during Cover Design (waiting for author feedback/approval) and Proofreading (revision rounds).

toneGuidelines: Empathetic and professional: Authors are partners, not customers to be managed.
Acknowledge the author's concern upfront before providing technical explanations.
Be specific: Reference actual book titles, dates, royalty amounts, and production stages.
Own BookLeaf mistakes directly (e.g. payout delays or print defects) with zero corporate deflection.
Provide actionable next steps and definite timelines (e.g., 'within 48 hours', '5-7 business days').
